summary:
StellarSketch: Constellations Beyond Earth is an interactive educational platform designed to bridge the gap between complex aerospace engineering trade-offs and young space enthusiasts. Developed as a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, our web-based application allows students to explore the night sky from the perspective of real exoplanets discovered by astronomers. By combining authentic NASA exoplanet data and celestial star catalogs, the platform reimagines traditional constellations from completely new vantage points.

The project addresses the challenge by transforming oversimplified space concepts into an engaging, hands-on simulation where students can examine how distance and planetary positioning alter celestial navigation. Users can select different exoplanets, view dynamic star charts, and export high-quality visualizations to design and name their own constellations. This approach fosters critical thinking, creativity, and a deeper appreciation for mission planning.

This project is important because inspiring the next generation of explorers requires interactive tools that make space science accessible and imaginative. By leveraging open NASA data, StellarSketch empowers students to think like aerospace pioneers, bridging raw scientific data with creative problem-solving and nurturing future talent for space exploration.
details:
• What it does and how it works:
    • Project Nebula Duo is an interactive, web-based simulation platform designed to serve as a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.
    • The application integrates real-world astronomical datasets—such as the NASA Exoplanet Archive and celestial star catalogs—to calculate and render the night sky dynamically from the perspective of various exoplanets.
    • Users can select a specific exoplanet, view custom-calculated star charts, and experiment with celestial navigation trade-offs and spatial positioning.
    • Educational Value: Bridges the gap between complex aerospace engineering concepts and students, transforming oversimplified space science into an intuitive, hands-on learning experience.
    • Engagement: Encourages critical thinking and scientific curiosity by allowing learners to visualize how stellar coordinates change across different planetary systems.
    • Inspiration: Nurtures the next generation of space explorers, cultivating an early interest in aerospace mission planning and data literacy.
    • Frontend & Architecture: Developed using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a responsive and modular user interface.
    • Data & Simulation: Leverages NASA open data APIs and public astronomical archives to compute stellar positions.
    • Documentation & Design: Architecture and system design specifications (SRS and SDD) were meticulously structured to ensure a robust software lifecycle.
    • Innovative Perspective: Instead of viewing the universe solely from Earth, the project flips the perspective, allowing students to experience night skies from thousands of light-years away.
    • Design & Usability: The team prioritized clean UI/UX design to make complex astronomical data approachable and engaging for young minds.
    • Technical Feasibility: Careful consideration was given to performance optimization when rendering dynamic star fields, ensuring smooth interactive performance across modern web browsers.
